seed: Objects of type `arm` under action ACTION4 with touching neighbours [block,block,block,block,player] show mixed outcomes: pixels,w x1, no_change x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Ring+beam A1/A2 move y-/+6 carrying on-beam blocks; hit blocks pushed in a chain; any block y<2/y>58 cancels the whole move.
A4/A3 change beam w by +/-6 within [1,43]. Hypothesis resolved: arm A4 no_change = beam already at max w 43 (its own w field).
A hooked next/collected block (x == beam.x+w-5) drags all on-beam blocks; unhooked extend pushes blocks in the swept columns; a blocked group (x>48 or into ring) leaves the beam changing alone.
Tags: hooked next block alone on beam -> collected, rightmost todo -> next; unhooked collected reverts (next -> todo). Clicks/A5/A7 are no-ops.
Unconfirmed: ring y bounds (assumed 0..58), ordering with multiple collected blocks, ACTION5/7 effects.
